title: UISD Teachers of the Year drive off in new Hyundais — one-year leases honor two educators
excerpt: Elizabeth Guerra-Lara and Ariana Bermea-Mendoza, United ISD's 2026 Teachers of the Year, each received a one-year lease on a brand-new 2026 Hyundai Elantra.
content:
Two of United ISD's best teachers are driving home in brand-new cars. Elizabeth Guerra-Lara, a fourth-grade special education teacher at Perez Elementary School, and Ariana Bermea-Mendoza, a teacher and head volleyball coach at J.B. Alexander High School, were named the district's 2026 Elementary and Secondary Teachers of the Year — and for the third consecutive year, Charlie Clark Hyundai of Laredo surprised each honoree with a one-year lease on a brand-new 2026 Hyundai Elantra, according to United ISD.

District administrators, campus leaders, students, staff and families gathered with Superintendent Dr. Gerardo Cruz for the special presentation, the district said. The J.B. Alexander High School Drumline performed, and the Alexander volleyball players and the Perez Elementary fifth-grade Lady Roadrunners volleyball team turned out to cheer on their teachers.

Guerra-Lara, who the district says is known for a nurturing classroom built on differentiated instruction and strong relationships with families, called teaching a calling. "I'm very grateful and very proud to work for our district," she said. "This little girl from the southside is Teacher of the Year for UISD, and I am very proud."

Bermea-Mendoza, whose parents are both educators, has built a volleyball legacy at Alexander, with national recognition from the American Volleyball Coaches Association for surpassing 300 career wins and a Texas High School Coaches Association Region 7-6A Coach of the Year honor, according to the district. "We get to impact kids every single day," she said.

Charlie Clark, CEO and owner of Charlie Clark Hyundai, said being able to give back this way means everything to his team, and Dr. Cruz thanked the dealership for continuing to invest in educators and public education.

Source: United Independent School District (uisd.net).
